title: atlax claims overlaps (GET /v1/claims/overlaps?factory=<f>)
description: Hestia's answer to a laptop asking which of its factory's open claims overlap an open claim of another card (decisions.md 2026-10-31: claims warn, never block; facts travel through the forwarder, laptops poll this). One entry per (card of the asked factory, artifact, other open claim) whose designations intersect; designations holds only the shared ones. Names only, never element content. Scope kb:read (auth.json). Writer: the record (hestia card atlax-claims). Reader: the laptop's atlax tooling, which warns both FSEs. Sample: claims-overlaps.sample.json. An empty overlaps list means no overlap.

designations.description: Only the designations both claims name.

claimed_at.description: When the asked factory's card claimed.

with.description: The other open claim: may be the same factory (two cards on one laptop) or another.
